snippet.title: Purgatory Pitstop - Free Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Purgatory Pitstop is an intensely confronting, morally challenging choice-based narrative game with restaurant management elements.

Play the free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4210220/Purgatory_Pitstop/

You manage the only diner on the road to the infamous afterlife gate, where the downtrodden journey to willfully pass on. Do you exploit their sorry state for profit, attempt to show them a better way, or find a healthy balance between both to keep your struggling business afloat?

#gaming #gametrailers #choicegame
